items.title: Layer 4 vs Layer 7 Load Balancers
items.one_idea: L4 routes per connection on IP and port; L7 reads the HTTP request (path, host, header) so /pay and /images can go to different servers; trade-off content-aware routing vs less work per request in a typical design.
items.spoken_hook: /pay और /images request, दोनों एक ही server पर।
keywords: load balancer kya hota hai hindi
items.visual_idea: Two balancer boxes: the layer 4 box sees each request as a sealed envelope with only IP:port written on it; the layer 7 box opens the envelope, reads the URL on the letter inside, and sorts /pay to a payments group and /images to an images group.
items.everyday_anchor: A courier hub: one sorter reads only the city on the parcel; another opens the parcel slip and sends fragile items to a separate counter.
items.example: EXAMPLE: users hit /pay and /images; a layer 7 balancer routes by path to two server groups. Names and groups are invented.
items.hook_formula: relatable_stake: the viewer's own app with payment and image traffic landing on one server, plain statement
facts_to_verify: AWS: NLB fourth layer, ALB seventh layer, path/host/header routing, ALB HTTPS listener decrypts; NGINX: layer 4 proxying of TCP connections. L4 less work only as 'typical design'.
